toolbar_elements.label: Miei
toolbar_elements.comboQuery: select dynamo_user as id, dynamo_user as name from entrasp.employers where dynamo_user in(select distinct em2.dynamo_user from entrasp.employers em2 where em2.codice_azienda in (select em3.codice_azienda from entrasp.employers em3 where em3.dynamo_user='€global_username€'));

content.query: select count(tab.*) as conta_giorni_incompleti from (select true as dettaglio, true as insert_missing_mins, true as segna_ferie, true as segna_permesso, entrasp.dynamo_employer(gdr.dynamo_user) as employer, gdr.giorno, gdr.dynamo_user, gdr.min_richiesti as minuti_richiesti,min_rendicontati as minuti_rendicontati, greatest(gdr.min_richiesti-coalesce(min_rendicontati,0),0) as minuti_mancanti from entrasp.giornate_e_users_da_rendicontare gdr left join entrasp.minuti_rendicontati_users_con_permessi mr on gdr.giorno=mr.data and gdr.dynamo_user=mr.dynamo_user where gdr.dynamo_user in(select em.dynamo_user from entrasp.employers em inner join entrasp.employers em2 on em.codice_azienda=em2.codice_azienda where em2.dynamo_user='€global_username€') group by gdr.codice_ruolo,gdr.ruolo, gdr.centro_gest, gdr.giorno, gdr.dynamo_user, gdr.nome,gdr.min_richiesti, mr.min_rendicontati having greatest(gdr.min_richiesti-coalesce(min_rendicontati,0),0)>0) tab
